code_examples.section: ltm rule command DHCPv6 transaction id
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

DHCPv6::transaction_id
       This command returns transaction id field from DHCPv6 message.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv6::transaction_id

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns transaction id field from DHCPv6 message

       Details (syntax): DHCPv6::transaction_id

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns transaction id field from DHCPv6 message

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    log local0. "Transaction_id [DHCPv6::transaction_id]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	    --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
